title: Unit Number and Title

illustrates.quote: Do not insert a blank line between connected headings.

blocks.features: Small-caps banner heading, bold black, with a small red decorative ornament between "UNIT" and "ONE".
Very large bold red serif display type, on a tan textured banner background, directly beneath "UNIT ONE".

print.notes: Connected unit-number and unit-title headings with no blank line between them, per rule 4.3.3.
print.printFeatures: Boxed unit-opener banner: small-caps "UNIT ONE" above a very large red serif display title on a tan textured background.

braille.notes: Line 1 blank; line 2 centered heading "UNIT ONE" (whole-word capitalization indicator on each word); line 3 centered heading "The Short Story" directly beneath with no blank line, per 4.3.3; line 4 blank.

resolution: braille.lines agree; `print.blocks[0].text` resolved to title-case "Unit One" is WRONG -- the braille's double-comma indicator (",,unit ,,\"o") marks BOTH words as whole-word capitals, i.e. print reads "UNIT ONE" in full caps, matching run B, not run A's title-cased "Unit One". Both blocks are centered (level 1), confirmed by the centering-formula check on lines 2-3.
